recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中大量紅血球的血紅素被推向細胞一側，另一側只剩透明的細胞膜囊泡，形成水泡細胞／半鬼影細胞（blister cell/hemighost），為 G6PD 缺乏在氧化壓力（rasburicase）下溶血的特徵。
features: Numerous red cells with hemoglobin retracted to one side and a clear membrane-bound vesicle on the other (blister cells/hemighosts)
Eccentrocytes with sharply demarcated, crescentic pale zones
Occasional spherocytic and irregularly contracted red cells
Single small mature lymphocyte in the center
Scattered platelets; no schistocytes or red cell agglutinates evident
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous red cells in which hemoglobin is retracted to one side of the cell, leaving a sharply demarcated clear membrane vesicle, forming blister cells (hemighosts) and eccentrocytes, together with occasional irregularly contracted cells. A single small lymphocyte is present, and schistocytes and agglutination are not seen. Heinz bodies require a supravital stain for demonstration. Findings are consistent with acute oxidative hemolysis, as seen in G6PD deficiency after rasburicase exposure.

ddx.vs: MAHA shows fragmented schistocytes (helmet and triangle cells) with thrombocytopenia rather than intact cells with hemoglobin retracted to one side.
AIHA shows microspherocytes and polychromasia with a positive direct antiglobulin test, not blister cells.
Unstable hemoglobins also produce bite cells and Heinz bodies but are chronic and identified by heat or isopropanol stability testing with normal G6PD activity.
